official.snapshotNotice: October 28, 2026, 8:07 AM ET official compilation; 67 county originals for VBM and early voting verified. Separately timestamped live county reports may be newer.
official.dailyComparisonNote: Reported-count changes compare October 28, 2026, 8:07 AM ET with October 27, 2026, 8:07 AM ET (24 hours). Both snapshots have verified originals for all 67 counties and both methods. These are net reported changes, including revisions and backfills, not necessarily ballots cast during one day. The statewide P+V denominator fell by 45,802, including a 46,862 decline in Broward. Conversion-rate changes therefore reflect both additional returns and changes to the provided/requested pool; the denominator revision is not a decline in ballots cast.

overlapCorrection.note: 2 verified participants appear in both reported methods; unique combined participation counts each voter once, while method counts remain unchanged. County and party details are preserved in source verification.

coverage.note: All 67 VBM and all 67 early-voting county originals have October 28 portal uploads and reconcile to the 8:07 AM official compilation. No prior county records substituted. Portal upload dates are separate from individual activity dates; unchanged file hashes are disclosed. Sarasota retains 26 early records dated October 12. Live county totals may be newer and cannot be allocated to districts without newer district-coded files.

definitions.provided: VoteByMail status P (provided, not yet returned).
definitions.returnRate: Returned divided by sent/provided universe (V ÷ (P + V)).
definitions.early: Reported early in-person ballots from separate EVL county originals
definitions.cast: Unique recorded voters across returned VBM and early voting; same-person cross-method records counted once. Reported method counts remain unadjusted and reconcile to official sources.
